children: Offerpad, through subsidiary OP SPE Summit, entered into a First Amendment to its Second Amended and Restated Revolving Loan Agreement to increase uncommitted borrowing capacity from $100 million to $150 million. The amendment, signed with WHGG II Trust and Ascent Developer Solutions, maintains customary covenants and events of default. The added capacity is expected to enhance liquidity and support ongoing operations.
